heading: Tonight
text: Localized evening showers or a thunderstorm, tapering off. Becoming partly clear, with a few patches of fog. Lows in the upper 50s to low 60s, some mid 60s near Lake Champlain. Winds light and variable, continuing from the south near 10 mph near Lake Champlain, a few gusts to 20 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: A few patches of fog early, burning away to morning sun east of the Greens. Clouds and showers spreading from Central New York. Scattered storms over New York spreading into southwestern VT around noon, then NH and northern VT by the evening. Highs in the low to mid 80s, some 70s in the higher terrain. Winds becoming south to southeast near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Widespread showers or thunderstorms from the Adirondacks and I-89 west, scattered to the north. Lows in the 50s to near 60, some mid 60s near Lake Champlain. Winds southeast near 10 mph, diminishing overnight.
